supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of c.rwong at 13:45:17 UTC, with ruth.moss as the subject. This is later than the alert's approximate 13:42 time.

The new account was added to the Seasonal group by ruth.moss five seconds after creation. The c.<name> format and Seasonal membership match the supplied description of the help-desk temporary-account practice.
The recorded creator, ruth.moss, is identified in the supplied environment context as help desk staff authorized to create domain accounts.

A network logon for ruth.moss from WS-RMOSS-01 was recorded at 13:41:11 UTC; the workstation session was locked at 13:43:57 UTC, before the account creation. These records provide timing context but do not establish that the creation was unauthorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the account creation and Seasonal group addition, but do not show the process or tool that performed them. Relevant account events: T198-00051, T198-00052.
The records do not provide a complete view of c.rwong's group memberships or effective privileges; the observed Seasonal addition alone does not establish that no other memberships exist. T198-00052.

The workstation lock and preceding network logon are recorded, but these events do not establish who initiated the account creation or whether an authenticated network session remained in use. T198-00049, T198-00050, T198-00051.
